title: A site made again under a deleted site's address is written from its own Customize answers, and never answers the deleted site's brief
steps: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/brief-build.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of the two tests named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'a site deleted and made again under the same address is written from its own answers, not the deleted site's' is ok: after createSite → start(About 'Repro One') → applied → deleteSite → createSite → start(About 'Repro Two'), start answers {started: true}, the engine is called twice, its second call reads 'Repro Two', and briefOf returns the 'Repro Two' brief.
'a site made again with no brief under a deleted site's address answers no brief at all' is ok: gate answers {open: false, step: null} with no state, and briefOf returns null.
Every other test of brief-build.test.mjs stays ok (a second press of the same build is still one piece of work).

selectors.store: putBrief, briefOf, markProvisioned and CURRENT in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-store.js

evidence: Site questions check, local stand on develop, 12/10/2026 (EmDash Tracy Business 1.7.16, real doors): name 'Repro One' → <title> 'Repro One'; DELETE left the site_brief row; same address with name 'Repro Two' → <title> 'Home — Northgate Industrial' (the template's own) while the job answered briefState applied with round one's notes and row created_at.
fence: The real brief runner and store over a scratch Postgres schema with engine and normalize doubles; the site row written and deleted with the real store functions. Not exercised: a running CMS and the HTTP doors (covered by the local-stand repro in the PR).

tests: a site deleted and made again under the same address is written from its own answers, not the deleted site's
a site made again with no brief under a deleted site's address answers no brief at all
